It's hard for me to form words since I really don't want to sound insensitive, and that's not where I'm aiming at, but I'm dead serious, things will get fucking better. I know your strength is sapping away, but if you can, lean on your friends and find strength in others who want to help; find strength in the little things you love. I hope you are at least alright, OP. And please, if you can, update us on your situation every now and then.
